PowerShell($items = Get-ChildItem -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'frontend' -and $_.Name -ne 'backend' }; Write-Output \("Moving " + $items.Count + " items into frontend/..."\); $errors = @\(\); foreach \($item in $items\) { try { Move-Item -LiteralPath $item.FullName -Destination 'frontend\\' -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $errors += "FAILED: $\($item.Name\) — $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } }; if \($errors.Count -gt 0\) { Write-Output "Errors:"; $errors | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ } } else { Write-Output 'all moved cleanly' })
